verdict.rationale: The 01 is an open-source device platform that runs its own servers (Light and Livekit), so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. However, every probed OpenAPI or Swagger path returned 404, and no evidence mentions a downloadable spec. The llms.txt file that exists is a docs index, not an API specification, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
